cards.title: Your round 7 notes
cards.text: 4 keys and no door, the Hulk on straight lines, slower statuses, merged gas clouds.
cards.why: Everything from the last deck. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details: Version 0.11.0. Close and reopen the app twice to get it.

parts.title: 4 keys
parts.text: No door. Four random camps have a gold-ringed keeper with a key. The 4th key clears the floor and you move on.

parts.title: Hulk
parts.text: Rolls only along straight lines, turning 90 degrees at a time on a cooldown. It arrives in the biggest room you can't see.

parts.title: Statuses
parts.text: Build-up about half as fast, and after a burst (freeze, rot...) that enemy can't burst from it again for 5 s.

parts.title: Gas clouds
parts.text: Drawn on the floor under walls and everything, overlapping clouds as one shape.

parts.title: Shard
parts.text: Here it is: the double star, close up.
